## `neuro.string.charCodeAt`

Instance method on `String.prototype`.

> Returns the Unicode value of the character at the specified location.

## Signatures

```ts
charCodeAt(input: { string: <receiver>; index: number; prompt?: string }): Promise<number>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `String.prototype.charCodeAt` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
